mapper.update: UPDATE trade_order SET status = 3 WHERE id = #{id} AND (buyer_id = #{userId} OR seller_id = #{userId}) AND status IN (0, 1)

UPDATE trade_order SET status=#{targetStatus},status_before_dispute=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND status=5
UPDATE trade_order SET status=2,status_before_dispute=NULL,finished_at=COALESCE(finished_at,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) WHERE id=#{id} AND status=5
UPDATE trade_order SET status=3,status_before_dispute=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND status=5
